decision_evidence_not_proof: Most EC missing claims are the four general-property alternatives already stated in the delivered guidance. This is not solely a missing-library or routing-delivery failure.

All eight Oregon-p amount errors output400 although the relevant actual instruction states the lesser of value and400 and the released target amount is literally in the public facts with the asset. This is a concrete value-cap application gap, not just an absent numerical instruction.

These observations do not isolate why the actor did not produce those answers: condition interpretation, guidance representation, attention and sampling remain possible. Larger teacher inputs or more skill records alone are not established remedies.

If mature same-actor static/text controls are insufficient, investigate executable use of concise procedures and exact missing/spurious TRAIN claim feedback rather than only longer law summaries. Any learning/actor change needs a new frozen protocol and matched new runs.
Do not fix these eight cases, automatically insert general citations or clamp numeric outputs; neither a runtime solver nor answer repair was added.
limits: All sources are seen TRAIN used for admission, not TEST or independent validation.
Literal instruction delivery is not proof of causal skill use or generalization. Targets are pinned benchmark labels, not expert legal judgments.
The wrong-amount inventory uses the existing upstream5percent matching rule; no scores or tolerance were changed.
